# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "trcm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "trcm-theory.html",
    Implementation = "trcm-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "trcm-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "trcm-validation.html"
  )
)
```

TRCM is checked against cylindrical FEM references for liquid-filled and gas-filled straight/bent bodies over frequency, angle, size, and curvature/material cases.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::

## TS-Frequency

Frequency rows retain the matched target and orientation while sweeping frequency.
